## `neuro.date.toLocaleDateString`

Instance method on `Date.prototype`.

> Returns a date as a string value appropriate to the host environment's current locale.
>
> Converts a date to a string by using the current or specified locale.

## Signatures

```ts
toLocaleDateString(input: { date: <receiver>; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
toLocaleDateString(input: { date: <receiver>; locales?: string | string[]; options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
toLocaleDateString(input: { date: <receiver>; locales?: Intl.LocalesArgument; options?: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Date.prototype.toLocaleDateString` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
